SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.artist FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE (c.power = '*' OR c.power IS NULL) AND l.format = 'commander' AND l.status = 'Legal';
SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.name, s.isForeignOnly FROM sets s JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code WHERE c.name = 'Adarkar Valkyrie';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 AND layout = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN isTextless = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pct FROM cards;
SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM cards c JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.rarity = 'mythic' AND l.format = 'gladiator' AND l.status = 'Banned';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cards WHERE originalType = 'Summon - Angel' AND (subtypes IS NULL OR subtypes <> 'Angel');
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN language = 'Chinese Simplified' THEN id END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(id) AS pct FROM foreign_data;

WITH fmt_counts AS (SELECT format, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM legalities WHERE status = 'Banned' GROUP BY format), top_fmt AS (SELECT format FROM fmt_counts ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT tf.format, c.name FROM legalities l JOIN top_fmt tf ON l.format = tf.format JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE l.status = 'Banned';
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN fd.language = 'French' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM cards c JOIN foreign_data fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '*';
SELECT c.name, c.artist, c.isPromo FROM cards c JOIN (SELECT uuid, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM rulings GROUP BY uuid ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 1) r ON c.uuid = r.uuid;
SELECT DISTINCT st.translation FROM cards c JOIN set_translations st ON st.setCode = c.setCode WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen' AND st.language = 'Italian';
